positions.title: Full-stack Developer
positions.description:
Developed microservices and custom tools using python and PyQt.
Designed and developed MERN Stack web application for syncing data.
Configured and deployed web applications using docker and Developed CI/CD pipeline using Jenkins.
Responsible for debugging and troubleshooting Web application issues.
Working in an Agile environment and using bitbucket for code management and code rereview

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Design, develop, test, deploy and maintain the website.
Designed and developed the UI of the website using HTML, AJAX, CSS and JavaScript.
Developed frontend and backend modules using Python.
Rewrite existing Python/C++/ Java module to deliver certain format of data.
Generated property list for every application dynamically using python.
Handled client-side validation using JavaScript.
Creating unit test/regression test framework for working/new code.
Created Test Plan test cases and automated test scripts in python.
Responsible for debugging and troubleshooting the web application.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
Developed startup script to make automation of configure of amazon Alexa in product using python. Developed API using python for product.
Developed company website using Node.js and html 5. 
Designed responsive UI designs using Bootstrap, HTML, SASS. 
Responsible for transforming design mock-ups to W3C standards compliant HTML pages using HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript. 
Hosted company site on AWS

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
Assist with (2) undergrad courses: Data Structure & Algorithms and Programming Language Concepts. 
Grade all student coding assignments and test codes.
Helping students understand and develop concepts of data structures.

positions.title: Software Engineer Consultant
positions.description:
Contracted long-term with US based company SteepRock Inc.; worked remotely from India.
Configured websites for the various clients as per their requirement on company framework.
Worked extensively with agile software methodology.
Familiar with JSON based REST Web services and Amazon Web services. 
Experienced in developing Web Services with Python programming language. 
Creating complex dynamic HTML UI using jQuery. 
Very strong full life cycle application development experience.
Experienced in installing, configuring, modifying, testing and deploying applications with Apache.
Utilized and created MySQL Queries.
Managed internal wiki (dokuwiki) and issue tracking system (Bugzilla) to help document and manage issue.
Version control using GitHub. 
Participated in project meetings

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Developed applications as per client requirements in Python, Django, Web2py, and enigma2.
Responsible for gathering requirements, system analysis, design, development, testing, and deployment. 
Involved in Web development, programming, and engineering Django, UWSGI and SQL internal admin tools behave BDD. 
During development, closely communicated with clients to better understand requirements, to perform analysis, design solutions, develop applications, and to provide delivery of solutions. 
Developed plugins for enigma2 based setup box in Python.
Created Business Logic using Python to create Planning and Tracking functions.
Develop backend functionality using Python. 
Maintain and improve Python scripts that use PostgreSQL.
Designed and developed the UI of the website using HTML5, XHTML, AJAX, CSS3 and JavaScript
Created UI Screens for initiation and validation.
Worked in agile and waterfall methodologies with high-quality deliverables delivered on-time.
Created a Git repository and added the project to GitHub.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Assisted in the live project involving Python-based software Platform for EDA.
Involved in nascent stage startup.
Assisted with designing several types of GUI visualization; results enabled faster data analysis.
Significantly strengthened Python and PyQt skills and knowledge during the internship.
Involved in Unit testing and Integration testing.
Gained exposure to front-end as well as a back-end of the project.
Experience with Unit testing/ Test-driven Development (TDD), Load Testing.
Wrote Python scripts to parse XML documents and load the data into a database. 
Used Python based GUI components for the front-end functionality such as selection criteria, 
Developed python scripts, which help to run unit test automatic and give details about the failure.
Experienced in Python's modules numpy, matplotlibetc for generating complex graphical data, a creation of histograms etc.

projects.title: Security in WiMax
projects.description:
Written research paper on Security in WiMax.
Did case study on 4-5 articles related to WiMax

projects.title: Email Application
projects.description:
Configure local Apache James Server in local.
Configure Application with local James Server.
Useful to create own host and create own Email server.
Use Java,EJB,JSF.
